To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of a novel once-daily insulin detemir (Lantus) in type 2 diabetic patients was safe and effective in a large international observational study.

(1) the majority of the patients in this study were not achieving their glycemic goals; (2) most patients were not receiving the recommended dose of insulin detemir; (3) most patients reported a good or very good treatment satisfaction with insulin detemir.
